user.title: Connect to Music Assistant
user.description: Piraten.FM stations are synchronized into the radio library of this Music Assistant server. Music Assistant servers with authentication enabled (API schema 28 and newer) require a long-lived token (Music Assistant → Settings → Profile → Long-lived access tokens).

data_description.url: The address of the Music Assistant web interface (port 8095 by default). Prefilled from the official Music Assistant integration when present.
data_description.token: Leave empty only for Music Assistant servers that do not require authentication.

reauth_confirm.title: Music Assistant token rejected
reauth_confirm.description: Enter a new long-lived Music Assistant access token.

error.invalid_auth: Music Assistant rejected the token or it lacks library permissions.
error.invalid_url: Enter an http(s) or ws(s) URL.

abort.already_configured: This Music Assistant server is already configured.
abort.wrong_server: This URL points to a different Music Assistant server.

data_description.missing_threshold: Number of consecutive successful syncs a station must be absent before it is removed.
data_description.include_frequency: Station names look like: Name • 97.00 MHz • Location.

auth_failed.message: Music Assistant rejected the access token.

entry_not_loaded.message: The selected Piraten.FM entry is not loaded.

remove_managed_stations.name: Remove managed stations
remove_managed_stations.description: Removes every radio this integration added from the Music Assistant library. Radios added by anyone else are never touched. Use this before uninstalling.

config_entry_id.name: Piraten.FM entry
config_entry_id.description: The Piraten.FM integration entry to clean up.
